judgment.promotion_v2_answer: PARTIAL. Promotion v2 reduces opportunity cost, but it still does not clear the promotion bar.
judgment.recommendation: Keep AddOn-only baseline unchanged. At most, run one final narrow promotion check on the single best repair candidate.
judgment.answer_1: Yes. The v1 failure is still consistent with bull/recovery opportunity cost. Best candidate still gives bull delta -225.46pp and recovery delta -48.82pp versus AddOn-only.
